title: Kleisli category
description: JSON Schema for the Kleisli category C_T of a monad T on C — the category whose objects are objects of C and whose morphisms A → B are morphisms A → T(B) in C (Kleisli 1965; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. VI §5). The categorical home of 'free T-algebras'; equivalent to the full subcategory of free objects in the Eilenberg-Moore category. Specializes category by carrying a monad cell.

monad.description: The monad T whose Kleisli category this is.
